adjusts.description: Basic waveform amplitude, peak-to-peak Vpp, AMP (C2:BaSic_WaVe?)
adjusts.name: amplitude

facts.text: The clone is a function-generator debug script tested on a Siglent SDG 2042X
The script opens the first VISA resource and queries *IDN? to confirm the instrument
The script writes C2:OUTP OFF, then C2:BaSic_WaVe WVTP,SQUARE,FRQ,100,AMP,2.5,OFST,1.25,DUTY,50, then C2:OUTP ON,LOAD,HZ,PLRT,NOR

operator_required.name: waveform
operator_required.reason: only the programming guide, a PDF the gate cannot read, lists the waveform types (page 20); the site supplies the types its bench uses

operator_required.name: frequency
operator_required.reason: the programming guide states the unit (Hz) but refers the range of valid values to the data sheet, which is not in the clone; the site supplies the range of its generator

operator_required.name: amplitude
operator_required.reason: the programming guide states the unit (Vpp) but refers the range of valid values to the data sheet, which is not in the clone; the site supplies the range of its generator output

operator_required.name: offset
operator_required.reason: the programming guide states the unit (V) but refers the range of valid values to the data sheet, which is not in the clone; the site supplies the offset range

operator_required.name: duty_cycle
operator_required.reason: only the programming guide, a PDF the gate cannot read, states 0 to 100 percent (page 20), and the range depends on the frequency; the site supplies the duty-cycle range
